propositions: The shipped per-criterion fan-out recovery explodes token cost (22 criteria × 20-request budget = 440 worst case) and wall-clock cost (25-90s sequential per criterion) while discarding verified work from a primary run that fails partway through

Replace per-criterion fan-out with incremental criterion-verdict banking into a run-scoped git-ignored store, recording verdicts as they are sufficient during the primary run and resuming unbanked criteria in batched successor runs

The flat primary step floor _VERIFY_MIN_STEPS=480 hands small-criteria tickets ~10× needed budget, manufacturing exhaustion; replace with criteria-scaled verify_step_floor(c)=clamp(8c,48,480) so typical tickets converge without recovery
Path-normalize the read_file memo key to cache whole-file content once per run and serve all line ranges from cache, collapsing the measured 77% re-read waste that feeds runaway loops

Emit full-coverage verdicts with banked criteria scored from evidence and unbanked criteria as met=false placeholders, never verdict-less; when finalizer fails, deterministic no-LLM fallback assembles the verdict from the bank and marks certifiable=false

Successor runs are batched over unbanked remainder criteria under a request budget pool (1.5× primary N), shared at system-prompt+tool-definition level via automatic prompt cache, with zero-progress breaker to stop recovery when no new verdicts are banked
